info.title: SHAPI advisory twilio-voice-insights-conference-participant-removed
info.summary: Twilio Voice Insights Call Summary drops attributes.conference_participant on 2026-08-01

workflows.summary: Shows the change: On August 1, 2026 Twilio removed the conference_participant attribute from the Voice Insights Call Summary (GET /v1/Voice/{CallSid}/Summary on insights.twilio.com) and the matching Event Streams event; attributes now returns null for every call. Code that reads attributes.conference_participant gets nothing, and code that dereferences attributes can throw.

steps.description: GET /v1/Voice/{CallSid}/Summary succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (field-rename)
